sops.title: Pumpdown drift: capture and escalation
sops.text: For this fictional scenario, preserve the pumpdown trend, record the observation and compare it with the approved scenario baseline. Recurrent drift remains OPEN and is referred to the equipment owner. Observation alone does not verify a repair; no operating limits or real service instructions are provided.

sops.title: Closure and handover evidence
sops.text: Keep the issue OPEN until a named person records the completed work and its verification evidence. Include the equipment ID, issue ID and next action in the handover. A completed unrelated inspection does not close a pumpdown issue. This demonstration cannot authorize equipment release.

sops.title: Reflected RF power: preserve event context
sops.text: For this fictional scenario, preserve the event time and context and refer repeated reflected RF power observations to the RF specialist. Keep the issue OPEN while the cause and verification are pending. Do not interpret a quiet interval or a completed cooling inspection as a verified RF repair.

sops.title: Cooling-loop inspection and release boundary
sops.text: Record the outcome of the fictional external cooling-loop checklist separately from the RF issue. Completion of that checklist applies only to its own issue ID. Operational release requires the real facility's approval process and is outside this demo.
